briefdescription.para: Checks if the receiver has data.

briefdescription.para: Checks if the transmitter is full.

simplesect.para: TRUE if the transmitter is full, FALSE otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Checks if the interrupt is enabled.

simplesect.para: TRUE if the interrupt is enabled, FALSE otherwise.

detaileddescription.para: The control register cannot be read, so this macro just writes the enable interrupt bit and clears all others. Since the only other ones are the FIFO reset bits, this works without side effects.
The control register cannot be read, so this macro just clears all bits. Since the only other ones are the FIFO reset bits, this works without side effects.

briefdescription.para: Sends a single byte using the UART.

detaileddescription.para: It is blocking in that it waits for the transmitter to become non-full before it writes the byte to the transmit register.

briefdescription.para: Receives a single byte using the UART.

detaileddescription.para: It is blocking in that it waits for the receiver to become non-empty before it reads from the receive register.

briefdescription.para: Low-level driver identifiers and functions for the UART Lite device.

detaileddescription.para: This header file contains identifiers and low-level driver functions (or macros) that can be used to access the device. High-level driver functions are defined in xuartlite.h.
